versos.texto_bv: Ai de vocês, escribas e fariseus, hipócritas! Porque vocês percorrem o mar e a terra para fazer um só prosélito, e, quando ele se torna um, vocês o fazem filho da geena duas vezes mais do que vocês.
versos.traducao_literal: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas, porque percorreis o mar e a terra seca para fazer um prosélito, e, quando se tornar, o fazeis filho da geena duas vezes mais do que vós.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): BV usa 'geena' (transliteração) enquanto as três referências convergem em 'inferno'. — evidência: BV: 'filho da geena'; NTLH: '...merecedora do inferno...'; ARA: 'filho do inferno'; NVIPT: 'filho do inferno'. Grego: γέεννα (G1067, γεέννης), confirmado no packet Nestle1904 — mesmo lema de 23.33.

kjv.texto: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

vizinhos.14: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
vizinhos.16: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

web.texto: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much of a son of Gehennaas yourselves.

vizinhos.14: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.
vizinhos.16: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

versos.texto_bv: Serpentes, raça de víboras! Como vocês escaparão da condenação da geena?
versos.traducao_literal: Serpentes, raça de víboras, como escapareis do juízo da geena?
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): BV usa 'geena' enquanto as três referências convergem em 'inferno'. — evidência: BV: 'condenação da geena'; NTLH: '...condenação do inferno' (parafraseado); ARA: 'condenação do inferno'; NVIPT: 'condenação ao inferno'. Grego: γέεννα (G1067, γεέννης), mesmo lema de 23.15 (packet Nestle1904).

kjv.texto: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

vizinhos.32: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
vizinhos.34: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

web.texto: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

vizinhos.32: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.
vizinhos.34: Therefore behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues, and persecute from city to city;
